analysis: Examined base_text lines 802-1635 of docs/architecture/inference.md (GLM media/prefix exclusion, measurements, calibration, deadlines, MTP, sampling, reasoning). None of these base lines changed; per the complete range map, the only head change is lines 2336-2348, which documents Flint constrained chaining and its maskCacheKey device-mask reuse. It also says RecursiveSI/flint-int4 is on the automatic paged list, starting at legacy width 8 on M5 Pro/Max/Ultra. That text matches base line 921-925, where unknown-profile auto-paged models start at the legacy ceiling of 8 with posture gating. The change is documentation of performance and decode behavior, with no change to the encryption, attestation, authorization, cache scoping or billing contracts. The mask cache holds constraint-state masks, not prompt-derived KV, so the T-041 cross-tenant prefix-cache and SSD at-rest posture are unaffected. The claim that the token stream is identical to unchained decode is a correctness and T-007-adjacent output-integrity statement. It is not evidenced by source in this batch; the implementation (CBv2 constrained chaining, RNG and penalty restore) should be verified in the batch containing the Flint/engine sources. No security regression was identified in the supplied units.
